summary: Deployed a WireGuard-gated service topology: node2 serves an HTTP app on TCP 8080, node1 (VyOS) terminates a WireGuard tunnel (wg0, 10.200.0.0/24) with node3 as the sole peer, and node2's iptables INPUT chain drops all TCP/8080 traffic except from the WireGuard subnet 10.200.0.0/24 (loopback explicitly excepted). node3 reaches node2:8080 only via the tunnel; a direct-LAN bypass attempt from node3 times out. Persistence (systemd units, netplan/systemd-networkd static route, iptables rules.v4 + restore service, WireGuard configs) was verified to survive a real reboot on all three nodes, performed sequentially with boot-id proof and post-restart functional verification.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: all three nodes share flat 10.100.173.0/24 network; node1=VyOS, node2/node3=Ubuntu 24.04
Generated WireGuard keypairs on node1 and node3 via wg genkey/wg pubkey
Configured VyOS wg0 on node1 (10.200.0.1/24, UDP 51820, peer node3 allowed-ips 10.200.0.2/32), committed and saved
Added VyOS firewall rules: input allow udp/51820, forward default-accept, verified ip_forward=1
Installed wireguard-tools on node3, configured wg0 (10.200.0.2/24, peer node1, endpoint 10.100.173.10:51820, allowed-ips 10.100.173.11/32), enabled wg-quick@wg0 service
Deployed demo HTTP app on node2 port 8080 via systemd unit demo-app.service (python3 http.server), enabled at boot
Added persistent static route 10.200.0.0/24 via node1 (10.100.173.10) on node2 using a scoped systemd-networkd .network file (40-enp1s0.network)
Restricted node2 port 8080 via iptables to source 10.200.0.0/24 only (plus explicit loopback accept), persisted via /etc/iptables/rules.v4 + restore-iptables.service enabled at boot
Verified end-to-end: node3 reaches node2:8080 via tunnel (success); direct LAN attempt via forced interface bypass fails (timeout); iptables counters confirm both accept and drop paths hit

Ran mandatory restart protocol sequentially on node2, node1, node3: captured pre-restart boot_id and functional baseline, issued native reboot (shutdown -r now / reboot) with async ack, polled until exec available again, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified service/tunnel/data recovery after each restart

evidence.requirement: node2 serves HTTP app on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: demo-app.service created, enabled, started; curl to 127.0.0.1:8080 returns app content

evidence.requirement: node1 VyOS WireGuard tunnel configured and established
evidence.summary: wg0 committed/saved on node1 with peer node3; handshake confirmed via wg show on both node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2:8080 only through the WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1
evidence.summary: curl via tunnel succeeds (10.200.0.2 src route to node2); forced direct-LAN curl via enp1s0 times out; node2 iptables counters show 5 pkts ACCEPT (tunnel) and 5 pkts DROP (direct LAN attempt)

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 37344ae4...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; post-poll boot_id changed to ba76f4ac...; demo-app active, iptables rules and static route persisted, node3 tunnel access re-verified

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id ebd78841... with active wg0/handshake; reboot ack returned; post-poll boot_id changed to 0fc1f84c...; wg0 auto-restored with fresh handshake, ip_forward=1, node3 confirmed app reachable via tunnel again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: baseline boot_id 4d70780a...; reboot ack returned; post-poll boot_id changed to 447d20c7...; wg-quick@wg0 active with fresh handshake, tunnel curl succeeds, direct-LAN bypass still blocked
